query:
SELECT s.id as sponsorId, s.companyName, i.id as intakeId, i.companyBoilerplate, i.keyChallenges, i.technologyType, i.targetOrgSize
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN intakeSubmissions i ON i.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE LOWER(s.companyName) LIKE '%udder%';
